verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring workflows is a fair question for a filing and payment portal with an API, for example scheduled maintenance-fee payments or recurring status checks, so the axis applies. However, no evidence shows any scheduler or recurring-job feature. Docketing and status tracking are one-off tracking features, maintenance-fee viewing is a storefront rather than a schedule, and the API probes show only an authentication-gated endpoint with no scheduling capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
